purpose: Preserve original four-row variable-index register-array form while making physical row 1 unread and unwritable; standard logical slots 1/2 share physical row 2.
scope: All 12 standard profiles, all legal P/U, Keygen/Sign/Verify with standard compiled ROM programs.
lifetime_proof: SLH Sign/Verify: H_msg writes slot1 before the first FORS tree; all FORS trees consume slot1; root compression writes slot2 only after the last FORS tree. No later command reads slot1.
SLH Keygen omits FORS and never consumes slot1.
XMSS/LMS never consume slot1; their message digest and chain/tree roots use slot2.
R slot0 and public-root slot3 remain independent because they can be live during message hashing and output.
No other task operand or node_value is merged; parent left and right remain simultaneously live.
notes: Physical mapped address bits are {logical[1]|logical[0],logical[1]&logical[0]}; all four logical indices exhaustively map to 0/2/2/3.
Only original logical slot1 constant references need remapping; slot0/2/3 references retain original array indices.
Identical standard-ROM lifetime restriction as digest_lifetime; no arbitrary custom ROM claim.
This structural variant still requires complete target matrix simulation and all three common syntheses before adoption.
